description: This file manages ACP (Agent Control Protocol) session bindings, including ensuring, resetting, and matching sessions based on configuration and session metadata.

methods.name: sessionMatchesConfiguredBinding
methods.description: Checks if a session's metadata matches the specified configuration and session parameters.

methods.name: ensureConfiguredAcpBindingSession
methods.description: Ensures an ACP binding session exists and is correctly configured, creating or reinitializing as needed.

methods.name: ensureConfiguredAcpBindingReady
methods.description: Checks if a configured binding is ready, ensuring its session is active and correct.

methods.name: resetAcpSessionInPlace
methods.description: Resets an existing ACP session in place, reinitializing it with the same parameters.
